generatedCommentsNodes.comment: Changing `platformLibDir` from `private` to `public` exposes an internal implementation detail to all callers. A `public static Path getPlatformLibDir()` accessor (or simply `public static Path platformLibDir()` following the existing naming convention in the class) would preserve encapsulation while still allowing `JnaNativeLibraryProvider` to read the value. This matters because `LoaderHelper` is a shared utility in `org.elasticsearch.nativeaccess.lib`; making the field public invites external code to depend on it directly, and any future refactoring (e.g., making it lazily computed or relocating the directory) would break all consumers.

review_comment: Will `toString` return a path with the right separators to be parsed properly on all platforms?

Yes. The javadoc for `Path.toString()` mentions the following:

> The returned path string uses the default name separator to separate names in the path.
Sounds good. I wasn't totally certain the "default name separator" was one that worked on all platforms.
Would it be better to do this in `SystemJvmOptions` rather than in a static initializer?

No, that was the problem we had before, it made NativeAccess unusable in the CLI. I moved it into here so that this can work even when we haven't gone through SystemJvmOptions (which is only for the main ES process).
